Task: Federated Login Flow

Write Python code that implements a PKCE login flow for public clients using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
import base64 import hashlib import os import secrets import threading import time import urllib.parse import webbrowser from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer import requests class Auth0PKCELogin: AUTHORIZATION_HOST = "https://{domain}/authorize" TOKEN_HOST = "https://{domain}/oauth/token" def __init__( self, domain: str, client_id: str, audience: str | None = None, scopes: list[str] | None = None, redirect_host: str = "127.0.0.1", redirect_port: int = 8765, timeout_seconds: int = 300, ) -> None: self.domain = domain self.client_id = client_id self.audience = audience self.scopes = scopes or ["openid", "profile", "email", "offline_access"] self.redirect_host = redirect_host self.redirect_port = redirect_port self.timeout_seconds = timeout_seconds @property def redirect_uri(self) -> str: return f"http://{self.redirect_host}:{self.redirect_port}/callback" def _generate_code_verifier(self) -> str: verifier = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(os.urandom(64)).decode("ascii").rstrip("=") return verifier[:128] def _generate_code_challenge(self, verifier: str) -> str: digest = hashlib.sha256(verifier.encode("ascii")).digest() return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(digest).decode("ascii").rstrip("=") def _build_authorization_url(self, state: str, code_challenge: str) -> str: params = { "response_type": "code", "client_id": self.client_id, "redirect_uri": self.redirect_uri, "scope": " ".join(self.scopes), "state": state, "code_challenge": code_challenge, "code_challenge_method": "S256", } if self.audience: params["audience"] = self.audience return f"{self.AUTHORIZATION_HOST.format(domain=self.domain)}?{urllib.parse.urlencode(params)}" def _exchange_code_for_tokens(self, code: str, code_verifier: str) -> dict: token_url = self.TOKEN_HOST.format(domain=self.domain) payload = { "grant_type": "authorization_code", "client_id": self.client_id, "code": code, "redirect_uri": self.redirect_uri, "code_verifier": code_verifier, } response = requests.post( token_url, json=payload, headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"}, timeout=30, ) response.raise_for_status() return response.json() def login(self, open_browser: bool = True) -> dict: state = secrets.token_urlsafe(32) code_verifier = self._generate_code_verifier() code_challenge = self._generate_code_challenge(code_verifier) auth_url = self._build_authorization_url(state, code_challenge) result: dict = {} done = threading.Event() class CallbackHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler): def do_GET(self) -> None: parsed = urllib.parse.urlparse(self.path) if parsed.path != "/callback": self.send_response(404) self.end_headers() self.wfile.write(b"Not found") return query = urllib.parse.parse_qs(parsed.query) result["code"] = query.get("code", [None])[0] result["state"] = query.get("state", [None])[0] result["error"] = query.get("error", [None])[0] result["error_description"] = query.get("error_description", [None])[0] self.send_response(200) self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8") self.end_headers() self.wfile.write( b"

Login complete.

You may close this window.

" ) done.set() def log_message(self, format: str, *args) -> None: return server = HTTPServer((self.redirect_host, self.redirect_port), CallbackHandler) server.timeout = 0.5 server_thread = threading.Thread(target=self._serve_until_done, args=(server, done), daemon=True) server_thread.start() if open_browser: webbrowser.open(auth_url, new=1) else: print(auth_url) started = time.time() while not done.is_set(): if time.time() - started > self.timeout_seconds: server.shutdown() server.server_close() raise TimeoutError("Timed out waiting for Auth0 redirect callback.") time.sleep(0.1) server.shutdown() server.server_close() if result.get("error"): raise RuntimeError( f"Authorization failed: {result['error']}: {result.get('error_description') or ''}".strip() ) if result.get("state") != state: raise RuntimeError("State mismatch in OAuth callback.") code = result.get("code") if not code: raise RuntimeError("No authorization code received.") return self._exchange_code_for_tokens(code, code_verifier) @staticmethod def _serve_until_done(server: HTTPServer, done: threading.Event) -> None: while not done.is_set(): server.handle_request()
